verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Lease lifecycle and destruction semantics: all six states, fixed-term heartbeat validity, no-renewal reclamation, absolute maximum age, image-release draining, deferred destruction, and no reuse of reclaimed state are represented clearly.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: Warm-pool supervision lacks the required demand signal (R29), so the board does not fully represent demand-driven pre-booted supply management.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board covers the end-to-end request, warm/cold placement, lifecycle and destruction contract, runtime limits, output persistence, quotas, quarantine trigger, and operational metrics. Coverage is reduced by the absent demand input and by partial qualifiers around immediate warm-hit return, per-call network policy, output delivery to the agent, quarantine-based placement exclusion, and reserved-capacity protection.
